items.source_en:
Don't worry. I already found us a buyer. Some stupid shopkeeper in Cydonia spent her life savings to take it off our hands. She seemed really happy about it and didn't ask any questions. Didn't even ask for my name. So I don't think there's gonna be any problems - at least not for us. Surely someone's gonna come looking for that ship sooner or later. I'm just glad it's not us who have to worry about it.


-Deke

-------------------------------------------------------------------------

One of the guys said he might have been spotted by SysDef when we jacked that weird custom cargo ship, and this thing's too huge to fit in the hangar, so our options to scrub it may be limited. I think our best bet's to cut our losses and offload it as quickly as possible. I don't care the price. Just get rid of it.

-Hannibal

- 디크
